comparison.objective: Set and lock a gripper opening limit versus make space in a stocked shelf row and insert a new carton in order.
comparison.physical_skill: Candidate uses precision coupled rotation with two tools; stocking requires sliding or relocating multiple upright cartons and placing another into a constrained gap.
comparison.success_condition: Candidate checks angular tolerance, lock retention, and repeated motion; stocking checks ordered upright placement of all five cartons, separation, stillness, and gripper clearance.
comparison.reason: This is constrained rearrangement rather than mechanical calibration or locking.
